description: This Java class ‘ClaimsBasedAuthorizationService’ implements an authorization service that makes authorization decisions based on asserted claims contained within a HonoUser. It provides methods to check if a user is authorized for a specific resource and activity or operation, returning a Future<Boolean> indicating the result.

classes.name: ClaimsBasedAuthorizationService
classes.description: Final class implementing AuthorizationService, responsible for authorization decisions based on user claims.
